headlines.headline: Giannis nears triple-double as Heat close out preseason unbeaten run
headlines.detail: Antetokounmpo turned in his best number since arriving in Miami as the Heat beat the Nets 144-128 to wrap the preseason. The real season opens Tuesday at 3 PM ET with Boston at Detroit.

headlines.headline: Cardinals send Marvin Harrison Jr. to Texans as deadline maneuvering heats up
headlines.detail: Arizona dealt the 2024 No. 4 overall pick to Houston, the latest domino after Baltimore's Cam Jurgens trade and Pittsburgh's Porter deal, with the Nov. 10 deadline three weeks out.

headlines.headline: Six ranked-vs-ranked showdowns headline loaded Week 7 Saturday
headlines.detail: Behind No. 1 Georgia, today's slate features Ohio State-Indiana, Texas-Florida, Alabama-Tennessee, and Notre Dame-BYU, with results still rolling in.

headlines.headline: Florida, Duke set as preseason co-favorites amid eligibility chaos
headlines.detail: Way-too-early rankings have the Gators and Blue Devils atop the sport ahead of their Dec. 1 ACC/SEC Challenge meeting, as the NCAA's new eligibility rule draws lawsuits.
